7.1.3.1.1 PNC gateway related requirements
[SWS_ComM_01066] ⌈When in main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION at least
one PNC bit representing this PNC in ERAn changes to ’1’, then the main state COMM_-
PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the sub state COMM_PNC_REQUESTED
shall be entered under the following conditions:
• the parameter ComMPncGatewayEnabled (see [ECUC_ComM_00887]) is set
to TRUE
• this PNC references at least one channel via ComMChannelPerPnc (see
[ECUC_ComM_00880]) and all referenced channels have the ComMPncGate-
wayType set
⌋(SRS_ModeMgm_09257, SRS_ModeMgm_09270)
Note: All the channels shall have GW type set which are referred by the PNC irrespec-
tive of the type of the reference i.e ComMChannelPerPnc or ComMChannelPerTx-
OnlyPnc.
